title: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
abstract: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.
tldr: WorldRecon 提出生成式多视角网格重建框架，从无位姿 RGB 图像恢复大规模完整 3D 场景网格。
motivation: 从无位姿多视角图像重建大规模场景的完整高质量网格，需要兼顾几何保真与对未观测或稀疏区域的合理补全；现有方法难以同时实现大规模一致性与完整生成。
method: WorldRecon 先利用重建模型估计的粗噪全局点云与相机位姿作为全局脚手架，并将场景划分为重叠空间块；为原生 3D 生成模型 TRELLIS.2 加入基于重建的条件架构，从局部点云裁剪和块相关图像生成稀疏结构、细节几何与 PBR 材质；再通过邻域感知 latent inpainting 和因果世界生成流程，在重叠块间传播结构、几何与材质上下文。
result: 在合成与真实室内场景上，WorldRecon 达到最先进重建性能，Chamfer distance 分别降低 14.9% 和 43.1%，F-score 分别提升 17.3% 和 12.0%，并展现出强 sim-to-real 泛化能力。
conclusion: WorldRecon 证明生成式多视角重建可扩展到大规模场景并输出连贯统一网格，其重建条件生成、邻域潜在修补与因果世界生成设计推动了完整高保真 3D 世界重建。

title: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
abstract: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.
tldr: 提出SchemaPose，用参数化类别Schema引导RGB类别级9D位姿估计，在合成与真实数据上达到SOTA。
motivation: RGB单目类别级9D位姿估计需泛化到未见实例并同时推断3D平移、旋转与尺寸，且类别级设置要求网络同时学习类内共性与实例差异。在仅有RGB时，位姿线索、类别共性与实例变化纠缠于外观且缺乏直接几何约束，现有框架难以学到与类别级估计目标真正对齐的表示。
method: 提出SchemaPose，一种模式引导的RGB类别级位姿估计框架；它引入显式参数化Schema来建模类别级规律与结构化实例变化，并在端到端查询式框架中用推断出的Schema变量引导位姿相关预测。该统一形式还支持模板实例化、合成标注与位姿学习。
result: 在合成与真实数据上的实验表明，SchemaPose在RGB类别级9D位姿估计方法中达到最先进性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SchemaPose通过参数化类别Schema统一了类别规律建模、实例变化表示与位姿预测，为RGB类别级9D位姿估计提供了新范式，并在合成与真实场景中验证了其有效性。

title: Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics
abstract: Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.
tldr: ReStep逆转前向预测：先预测终态，再用锚定扩散生成中间轨迹，缓解长时漂移。
motivation: 自回归轨迹预测会累积误差，导致长时推演严重漂移；而在摩擦滑动、摆锤稳定等耗散或趋于静止的物理系统中，最终状态往往比瞬态动力学更易预测。
method: 提出ReStep级联框架：先用随机模型直接预测最终状态，再以Anchored Diffusion生成目标条件中间轨迹；通过同时以两个边界状态为条件约束动力学、降低不确定性，并作为物理引擎集成到3D Gaussian Splatting中，实现从图像进行物理-视觉联合推理。
result: 在多种刚性与非刚性碰撞数据集上，ReStep取得更优的长期预测精度，显著缓解误差累积；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过反向后果建模逆转传统前向预测范式，为长时粒子动力学提供物理合理且时间连贯的轨迹，并展示与3D高斯泼溅结合的统一物理-视觉框架在机器人控制与力学理解中的潜力。

title: PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.
tldr: PUGS将水下高斯运动建模为概率分布，以物理引导不确定性提升动态3DGS重建质量。
motivation: 现有动态3DGS依赖确定性变形场，假设每个高斯沿确定几何轨迹运动，但水下光散射、折射、海雪和低能见度造成显著物理歧义，使该假设失效，重建质量与鲁棒性下降。
method: PUGS学习水下成像形成过程固有的不确定性，并将其作为物理信号指导动态建模；不再估计单一确定性位移，而是将每个高斯的运动参数化为含期望形变与物理不确定性的概率分布，通过局部重参数化进行随机形变优化以采样多条合理轨迹；进一步提出不确定性随机退火与双路径自一致性蒸馏目标，将随机探索转化为确定性重建并保持时序连贯。
result: 在水下动态数据集与物理感知基准上，PUGS在渲染质量、时序一致性和重建鲁棒性上均优于现有方法；在UVEB上PSNR比最强基线提升1.16 dB，在DRUVA上提升3.99 dB。
conclusion: 该工作表明物理引导的不确定性建模能有效应对水下动态场景的物理歧义，为水下动态3DGS提供了一种鲁棒的概率化重建框架，对真实水下感知与建模应用具有潜在价值。

title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.
tldr: 提出融合LiDAR-惯性SLAM与RGB-热成像的自主3D光伏巡检系统，实现板下部件检测与空间定位。
motivation: 公用事业规模光伏巡检主要依赖空中勘测，虽能识别组件级热斑，却难以观察阵列下方的连接器、线缆、紧固件和结构件；这些资产缺陷小、易遮挡，且从孤立图像中难以定位。
method: 提出自动化3D视觉-热成像巡检系统Tricorder，将LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定的RGB及热成像结合，并利用机器学习进行目标检测与分割；检测到的资产与重建的3D环境关联，从而融合多视角视觉与热观测并实现空间定位。
result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证了MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及螺栓、螺母和扭矩管等结构部件检测；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作展示了从基于图像的巡检迈向空间落地的自主巡检路径，使缺陷能够关联到具体资产及其在光伏场中的3D位置，提升板下关键部件的可规模化、一致性检测能力。

title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
abstract: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr: 4LC提出4D潜在缓存，复用静态与动态视觉表征，高效条件化动态世界视频生成。
motivation: 动态世界建模中，不同时间和视角的重复视频生成需要高效复用已观测的静态与动态内容作为条件，而逐请求的RGB渲染与重编码会造成效率瓶颈。
method: 提出4LC，将VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT等多视觉编码器的表征绑定到共享几何与运动，形成复合4D潜在缓存，并提供可按独立指定时间和视角读取、融合多观测读出的灵活时空接口，作为统一条件格式。基于4LC构建4LC-Video，通过配置源观测、时空请求和历史复用支持多种生成任务。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验表明，单一4LC-Video无需任务特定微调即可处理相机控制、时间控制、新视角合成、场景重访和长期生成，并实现更高效的条件获取、有效的时空可控性以及跨任务场景一致性。
conclusion: 4LC通过潜在缓存和多编码器复合表征避免重复RGB渲染与重编码，为动态世界建模提供统一高效的条件获取方式；其无需任务特定微调的通用性有望推动多任务视频生成与动态场景建模。

title: PLEDGE: Progressive Lossy Error-Bounded Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) codecs report reconstruction quality after compression, and give users little control over the distortion of individual primitives. We present PLEDGE, a training-free, progressive, error-bounded codec that translates four user-declared tolerances into per-primitive quantization bounds: screen-space position, footprint deformation due to rotation and scale, view-dependent color, and opacity. The bounds apply throughout a declared camera domain, including previously unseen viewpoints. Position and opacity are bounded directly; footprint deformation is bounded under the rasterizer's affine projection model, and color is bounded over all viewing directions. PLEDGE organizes quantized residuals into a progressive bitstream with explicit error bounds for every valid prefix. Experiments across thirteen scenes verify all declared per-mechanism bounds and demonstrate competitive rate-distortion performance. The four tolerances incur substantially different rate costs, so users can spend rate where their application needs it.
tldr: PLEDGE提出免训练、渐进且误差有界的3DGS压缩编解码器，将用户设定的四类容差转化为逐图元量化边界。
motivation: 现有3DGS编解码器通常只在压缩后报告重建质量，用户难以控制单个图元的失真。PLEDGE旨在将用户声明的四类容差转化为可验证的逐图元误差边界，并在包含未见视角的相机域内保持约束。
method: PLEDGE无需训练，将屏幕空间位置、旋转/尺度造成的足迹变形、视角相关颜色和不透明度四类用户容差转化为逐图元量化边界。其中位置与不透明度直接约束，足迹变形在光栅化仿射投影模型下约束，颜色在所有观察方向上约束；量化残差被组织为渐进比特流，且每个有效前缀都有显式误差界。
result: 在13个场景的实验中，PLEDGE验证了所有声明的逐机制误差边界，并取得有竞争力的率失真性能。四类容差带来显著不同的码率开销，用户可按应用需求在相应机制上分配码率。
conclusion: PLEDGE提供了免训练、渐进、误差有界的3DGS压缩方案，提升了压缩失真的控制粒度和码率分配灵活性。其显式误差保证有助于面向需约束渲染误差和渐进传输的3DGS应用。

title: YUBI-Real2Sim: 3DGS Scene Verification for Reliable Policy Evaluation
abstract: Evaluating VLA policies on real robots is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce, making real-to-sim simulation essential for scalable evaluation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables rapid real-to-sim scene generation, the reconstruction quality required for reliable policy evaluation remains unquantified. In particular, policies relying on wrist-mounted fisheye cameras (e.g., YUBI handheld gripper data) are heavily exposed to visual artifacts (holes, floaters) in wide-angle views, directly degrading task performance. To address this, we present YUBI-Real2Sim, a unified framework for 3DGS-based scene reconstruction and real-to-sim policy evaluation under dual fisheye wrist views. We develop an integrated pipeline combining 200-degree fisheye camera capture, 3DGS training, 3D foundation models for object modeling, and MuJoCo-based physical simulation, reproducing the observed real-world policy ordering in eight of nine scene-task comparisons. Using this framework, we construct a benchmark across two bimanual robot platforms, three scenes, three tasks, and dual pi0.5-based policies. This systematically measures real-to-sim rank agreement and evaluates policy sensitivity against counterfactual 3DGS artifacts (ceiling holes, floaters, warping) and capture disturbances. We further analyze whether novel-view quality scores can indicate policy-ranking reliability under a scene-held-out evaluation protocol. The results show task-dependent performance and limitations of quality-based reliability prediction, highlighting the need to assess reconstruction quality when using Real2Sim for policy evaluation. These results do not yet establish a generally reliable scene-acceptance rule. Project Page: https://yubi-real2sim.airoa.io.
tldr: 提出YUBI-Real2Sim，用3DGS和MuJoCo在双鱼眼腕视角下重建场景并评估VLA策略可靠性。
motivation: 在真实机器人上评估VLA策略成本高、耗时长且难以复现，因此需要可扩展的real-to-sim仿真评估。但基于3DGS快速生成场景时，可靠策略评估所需的重建质量尚未量化，尤其腕装鱼眼相机在广角视图下易受孔洞、漂浮物等伪影影响并直接降低任务表现。
method: 提出YUBI-Real2Sim统一框架，面向双鱼眼腕视角进行3DGS场景重建与real-to-sim策略评估，流程整合200度鱼眼采集、3DGS训练、3D基础模型物体建模与MuJoCo物理仿真。构建覆盖两个双臂机器人平台、三个场景、三个任务及两个pi0.5策略的基准，系统测量real-to-sim排序一致性并评估策略对反事实3DGS伪影（天花板孔洞、漂浮物、扭曲）和采集扰动的敏感性。
result: 该流程在九组场景-任务比较中的八组复现了真实世界策略排序；基准揭示性能具有任务依赖性，且基于新视角质量分数的策略排序可靠性预测存在局限。结果尚未建立通用可靠的场景接受规则。
conclusion: 研究表明使用Real2Sim进行策略评估时必须评估重建质量，并凸显3DGS伪影与鱼眼视图对策略评估可靠性的影响；贡献在于提供可复现基准与伪影敏感性分析，为可靠real-to-sim策略评估奠定基础。

title: Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Scene Reconstruction: Methods, Systems, and Trade-offs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis. Since its inception in 2023, its explicit and highly configurable scene representation has been extended toward sparse-view generation, dynamic reconstruction, efficiency and compression, streaming, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although Gaussian Splatting can provide real-time rendering, rendering an existing representation is distinct from constructing, updating, or maintaining the scene itself. In this survey, we synthesize current literature, categorize them and provide a connection of current approaches and tools towards an end-to-end pipeline. Explicitly, we categorize GS scene reconstruction into five overlapping families: single-shot generation, dynamic representations, efficiency and compression, streaming and immersive systems, and Gaussian Splatting SLAM. We distinguish render-only throughput from task-specific scene generation, update, tracking, mapping, and optimization costs, and combine controlled sparse-view benchmarking with native evaluations to identify cross-family quality, latency, memory, and update-cost trade-offs.
tldr: 综述3DGS场景重建方法、系统与权衡，并按五类重叠方向梳理端到端流程。
motivation: 3DGS可实现高质量实时新视角合成，但其显式且高度可配置的场景表示已被扩展到稀疏视角生成、动态重建、效率与压缩、流式及SLAM等方向。然而，渲染已有表示与构建、更新或维护场景本身不同，缺乏对方法、系统与工具链的统一梳理。
method: 本综述将GS场景重建归纳为五类相互重叠的方向：单次生成、动态表示、效率与压缩、流式与沉浸式系统以及Gaussian Splatting SLAM；并区分仅渲染吞吐与任务特定的场景生成、更新、跟踪、建图和优化成本。作者结合受控稀疏视角基准与原生评估，分析跨类别的质量、延迟、内存和更新成本权衡。
result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果与量化指标；仅说明通过受控稀疏视角基准和原生评估来识别跨类别的质量、延迟、内存与更新成本权衡。
conclusion: 该综述连接现有方法与工具，提出面向端到端流程的分类框架，并强调需区分渲染吞吐与场景重建/维护开销。其贡献在于为3DGS场景重建系统提供跨方向权衡分析，可辅助后续研究选型与系统设计。

title: DIME: Scaling Facial Representation Learning via Differential Masked Autoencoding
abstract: Scaling up data and model capacity has driven substantial progress in visual representation learning. However, conventional pretext tasks exhibit diminishing returns on fine-grained facial analysis. We attribute this to a scaling bottleneck: these tasks model each image's appearance and are dominated by identity, pose, and illumination, so subtle within-identity facial differences contribute little to the training signal. We introduce DIME, a differential masked autoencoder for large-scale facial representation learning. DIME builds on a simple observation: two images of the same person share identity-specific appearance, so their difference exposes facial changes. DIME reconstructs both masked images in an identity-matched pair and, through an Explicit Differential Direction Supervision (EDDS) objective, aligns the direction of their reconstructed difference with the true difference, while source isolation makes each reconstruction depend only on its own image. Shared appearance cancels in this difference, and because EDDS ignores magnitude, subtle facial changes count as much as large pose or illumination changes. DIME uses identity labels only to form pretraining pairs, requires no dense annotations, and learns dense facial representations with emergent part-level semantics. We pretrain DIME on 20 million high-resolution facial images consolidated from existing face datasets. DIME's AU detection performance continues to improve as pretraining data scales from 6M to 20M images, with its BP4D F1 increasing by 5.9 points, while MAE gains only 0.5 points on the same subsets. DIME also outperforms specialized facial methods on AU detection, AU intensity estimation, cross-domain anti-spoofing, landmark localization, head pose estimation, face parsing, and face generation.
tldr: DIME通过同一身份图像对的差分掩码重建与差分方向监督，实现可扩展的细粒度人脸表征学习。
motivation: 扩大数据与模型规模对通用视觉表征有效，但现有预训练任务在细粒度人脸分析上收益递减；作者将其归因于缩放瓶颈：这类任务建模整幅图像外观，训练信号被身份、姿态和光照主导，同一身份内的细微面部差异贡献甚微。
method: 提出DIME差分掩码自编码器：对身份匹配的两张图像同时进行掩码重建，通过显式差分方向监督（EDDS）使重建差的方向与真实差对齐，并利用源隔离让每个重建仅依赖自身图像；差分中共享外观被抵消，且EDDS忽略幅度，使细微面部变化与大幅姿态/光照变化同等重要。该方法仅用身份标签构造预训练图像对，无需稠密标注，可学到具有部件级语义的稠密人脸表征。
result: 在由现有人脸数据集整合的2000万张高分辨率人脸图像上预训练；当预训练数据从6M增至20M时，DIME的AU检测性能持续提升，BP4D F1提升5.9个点，而MAE在相同子集上仅提升0.5个点。DIME在AU检测、AU强度估计、跨域反欺骗、关键点定位、头部姿态估计、人脸解析和人脸生成等任务上均优于专用人脸方法。
conclusion: DIME表明差分掩码自编码可突破细粒度人脸分析的缩放瓶颈，在无需稠密标注的情况下学习到部件级语义的稠密人脸表征，并为可扩展的人脸预训练提供了新范式。

title: 3D-VITAL: Visibility-aware Identity Training from Artificial Liftings of 3D Reconstruction model for Cross-View Object Re-Identification
abstract: We address the Cross-View Object Re-Identification (ReID) task, aiming to match identities across drastically different viewpoints. We focus on Single-View Aerial-Ground ReID (SV AG-ReID), where models train on one viewpoint and must generalize to another at inference. To bridge this viewpoint gap, related work employs generative models to synthesize novel views from source images as additional training data. We leverage recent advances in large-scale single-view 3D mesh reconstruction to lift source images into textured meshes and to render them from new viewpoints. However, this pipeline produces unreliable data in two distinct ways. First, the reconstruction may fail and produce geometrically incorrect meshes, resulting in severe corruption in rendered novel views. Second, even when the geometry is correct, the rendered novel views contain hallucinated textures in regions not visible in the source image. The reconstructed mesh carries a per-pixel partition between regions visible from the source view and regions that the reconstruction model had to hallucinate, available as a deterministic byproduct of rendering. We introduce this per-pixel visibility map and exploit it in a two-stage design. Cross-View Consistency Filtering (CVCF) discards geometrically incorrect meshes by ensuring multi-view consistency between source and novel views over visible patches. Visibility-Aware Attention Supervision (VAAS) leverages the visibility map to guide the model's attention toward reliable regions of the rendered view during training. Combined, these two components enable our method, 3D-VITAL, to better leverage the synthetic signal from single-view 3D mesh reconstruction. 3D-VITAL sets a new state-of-the-art on three SV AG-ReID benchmarks. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/3D-VITAL.
tldr: 提出3D-VITAL，利用单视图3D重建生成新视角并借助可见性图提升跨视角目标重识别。
motivation: 针对单视角空地对跨视角目标重识别中训练与推理视角差异显著的问题，现有方法用生成模型合成新视角训练数据，但单视图3D重建会因几何错误和不可见区域幻觉纹理产生不可靠数据。
method: 将源图像提升为带纹理3D网格并渲染新视角，利用渲染过程确定的逐像素可见性图，设计两阶段方案：CVCF通过源视角与新视角在可见区域的几何一致性过滤错误网格，VAAS依据可见性图引导模型注意力聚焦渲染视图中的可靠区域。
result: 摘要称3D-VITAL在三个SV AG-ReID基准上取得新的最先进性能，但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法能更有效地利用单视图3D网格重建产生的合成信号，提升跨视角目标重识别的泛化能力，代码与数据将开源。

title: Dense Endoluminal Mapping and Localisation from Monocular Bronchoscopy
abstract: Bronchoscopy inserts a camera through the airways to diagnose endoluminal disease. Locating the camera along the airway usually requires additional equipment, such as an electromagnetic tracker and a preoperative CT scan. In this paper, we investigate the use of the monocular camera stream to localise the bronchoscope without requiring additional sensing. We introduce a monocular SLAM system that localises the tip of a bronchoscope and reconstructs the airway surface around it from RGB video alone. A Depth Anything 3 backbone, fine-tuned on over a million photorealistic airway renderings, returns metric per-pixel depth and is the system's only source of scale. DINOv3 features routed through a custom cross-attention matcher supply sub-pixel correspondences on mucosa where classical descriptors fail. Both enter a factor graph alongside a dense constraint from projective iterative closest point (ICP) registration against the system's own running reconstruction, so surface evidence stabilises the directions the visual factors leave weakly observable. On six airways rendered from patient CT scans, the system reaches 26.1 mm mean absolute trajectory error and 77.5% mean surface F-score. Its mean surface accuracy exceeds that of five recent monocular SLAM and feed-forward baselines. MASt3R-SLAM, which fits a free scale to the ground truth, has a lower mean trajectory error (22.0 mm). ORB-SLAM3 completes only two of the six airways, whereas our system completes all six and also reconstructs two ex vivo specimens.
tldr: 提出仅用单目支气管镜RGB视频的SLAM系统，实现镜尖定位与气道表面重建。
motivation: 传统支气管镜定位通常依赖电磁追踪器和术前CT等额外设备。本文研究仅利用单目相机视频流定位支气管镜，无需额外传感。
method: 系统以在超百万张真实感气道渲染图上微调的Depth Anything 3提供逐像素度量深度，作为唯一尺度来源；DINOv3特征经自定义cross-attention matcher在经典描述子失效的黏膜上提供亚像素对应。视觉因子与基于自身运行重建的projective ICP密集约束共同进入因子图，用表面证据稳定视觉因子弱可观测方向。
result: 在六个由患者CT渲染的气道中，系统达到26.1 mm平均绝对轨迹误差和77.5%平均表面F-score，平均表面精度优于五个近期单目SLAM和前馈基线。MASt3R-SLAM将自由尺度拟合到真值后轨迹误差更低（22.0 mm），ORB-SLAM3仅完成六个气道中的两个，而本系统完成全部六个并额外重建两个离体标本。
conclusion: 结果表明仅凭单目RGB即可实现支气管镜密集腔内建图与定位，无需电磁追踪或术前CT，并在气道完成度和表面重建精度上具有竞争力，有望用于临床支气管镜导航。

title: G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation
abstract: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. Following the world-action-model paradigm, G$^2$WAM jointly predicts future states and actions, eliminating the need for costly cross-entropy method (CEM) style planning. In addition, G$^2$WAM operates entirely in latent space, avoiding the computational burden of pixel-level reconstruction and substantially reducing inference cost. Across four trajectory prediction benchmarks, G$^2$WAM reduces average ATE and RPE by 40.1% and 35.2%, respectively. In closed-loop navigation experiments, it improves the success rate from 54.0% to 63.0% and the success weighted by path length (SPL) from 36.4% to 59.2%, while maintaining high efficiency.
tldr: 提出G^2WAM，通过场景坐标定位与潜空间世界动作模型实现高效几何接地图像目标导航。
motivation: 图像目标导航中目标常在当前视野外，智能体需同时建模环境动态并保持持久空间记忆；现有方法微调预训练模型会浪费空间先验，外接3D重建则计算昂贵，难以实际部署。
method: G^2WAM通过可学习的场景坐标定位模块将当前帧、目标帧和历史帧锚定到统一参考系，提供稳定一致的空间上下文，无需显式3D重建；遵循世界动作模型范式联合预测未来状态与动作，省去CEM式规划，并完全在潜空间运行以避免像素级重建。
result: 在四个轨迹预测基准上，G^2WAM使平均ATE和RPE分别降低40.1%和35.2%；闭环导航中成功率从54.0%提升至63.0%，SPL从36.4%提升至59.2%，同时保持高推理效率。
conclusion: G^2WAM表明几何接地的世界动作模型可在不依赖显式3D重建和像素重建的情况下提升图像目标导航的精度与效率，为真实部署提供了高效新思路。

title: Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding. These findings show that high VAD performance should not be interpreted as evidence of abnormal-motion modeling without auditing the reliability of the person-observation pipeline. Our study provides a systematic protocol for evaluating observation-quality shortcuts and for assessing whether motion-based discrimination survives explicit control of detection, pose-estimation, and tracking reliability.
tldr: 提出观测质量感知评估框架，审计人体运动视频异常检测中由检测、姿态估计和跟踪可靠性带来的捷径。
motivation: 视频异常检测中的异常偏离不一定对应安全关键事件；在以人为中心的紧急与暴力场景中，基于运动的异常判别可能混杂人体检测、姿态估计和跟踪带来的观测质量差异，而非反映任务相关的真实运动信息。
method: 提出观测质量感知评估框架，结合质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化和鲁棒性分析；在UCF-Crime以人为中心类别上，对比仅质量特征与多线索运动特征，并通过基数匹配将11项质量变量控制在预设边际平衡阈值以下。
result: 原始队列中仅质量特征判别力匹配或超过多线索运动，显示强观测质量捷径；匹配后多线索运动在Logistic Regression、Random Forest和RBF-SVM上均优于仅质量特征，ROC-AUC提升0.046–0.141，但非线性仅质量预测仍高于随机，表明已测边际质量之外仍有额外判别信息。
conclusion: 高VAD性能不能直接视为异常运动建模成功的证据，必须审计人体观测流水线的可靠性；该研究提供了系统协议，用于评估观测质量捷径并检验运动判别在显式控制检测、姿态估计和跟踪可靠性后是否仍成立。

title: Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization
abstract: Repetitive structures can give an incorrect pose candidate more inlier support than an accurate one, causing visual localization to select it. History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR) uses coarse position forecasts from up to five past localization outputs to distinguish well-separated current-query candidates. The best-fitting forecast proposes an alternative; HPR accepts it only if every well-fitting forecast is much closer to it than to the localizer's pose. HPR needs no odometry and returns the selected candidate unchanged, using prediction for selection rather than pose refinement. With one development-set threshold, HPR improves recall within 5 meters and 10 degrees in all 12 main configurations of Hierarchical Localization (HLoc), MASt3R-based pose generation, and JIST-based retrieval, losing successes on fewer than 0.4 percent of queries. On NAVER Gangnam B1, HPR corrects 97 HLoc failures and loses six successes; gains persist within 0.25 meters and 2 degrees on all three HLoc test sets. Median HPR runtime on HLoc candidates is below one millisecond, excluding pose generation. Recovery weakens under less frequent localization.
tldr: HPR利用历史位姿预测重选候选，在重复结构下纠正视觉定位的位姿选择失败。
motivation: 重复结构可能使错误位姿候选获得比正确候选更多的内点支持，导致视觉定位系统选错候选；论文旨在从这种位姿选择失败中恢复，而不是直接优化位姿。
method: 提出 History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR)，用最多五次历史定位输出生成粗略位置预测，由最佳预测提出替代候选，并仅当所有拟合良好的预测都明显更接近该替代候选而非定位器位姿时才接受；HPR 不需里程计，也不改变所选候选，仅将预测用于候选选择。
result: 在 HLoc、MASt3R 位姿生成和 JIST 检索的全部 12 个主配置中，单一开发集阈值使 5 米/10 度内召回提升，失败损失低于 0.4%；在 NAVER Gangnam B1 上纠正 97 个 HLoc 失败、仅损失 6 个成功，并在三个 HLoc 测试集上保持 0.25 米/2 度内增益；HLoc 候选上 HPR 中位运行时间低于 1 毫秒（不含位姿生成）。
conclusion: HPR 表明历史位置预测可有效用于视觉定位的候选重选而非位姿精化，在重复环境下显著恢复选择失败且开销极低；但定位频率降低时恢复效果会减弱。

title: BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates
abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.
tldr: BAT3R提出免训练贝叶斯自适应框架，通过SIG和BASU缓解长序列在线3D重建的状态漂移与误差累积。
motivation: 前馈Transformer模型虽推动3D视觉发展，但其二次复杂度难以处理长视频序列；现有流式循环重建方法虽保持恒定内存，却忽略观测的内在可靠性与历史状态的累积置信度，导致长序列推理中严重误差累积和性能退化。
method: BAT3R是一个免训练的贝叶斯自适应框架，包含状态创新门控（SIG）与贝叶斯引导自适应状态更新（BASU）两个协同模块。SIG作为分布正则器将状态演化锚定到几何初始化以抑制表征漂移；BASU在卡尔曼滤波框架下将状态更新重写为递归贝叶斯推断，利用信息论增益建模观测的时序可靠性、利用交叉注意力图建模空间相关性，实现非对称时空状态融合：保护已巩固的历史区域免受冗余更新，同时积极纳入真正新颖的场景内容。
result: 在7-Scenes、TUM、ScanNet、KITTI等标准基准上，BAT3R持续优于当前最优的在线3D重建方法，并在长序列和复杂场景中取得最显著提升；摘要未提供具体的量化指标。
conclusion: BAT3R通过免训练贝叶斯自适应状态更新提升了在线3D重建的鲁棒性，其贡献在于无需额外训练即可缓解长序列误差累积，对长视频流式3D重建与复杂场景应用具有潜在影响。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-grained Urban Scene Reconstruction via Semantic-guided Density Control and Loss Design
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been becoming a promising 3D reconstruction technique because of its advantage of high-fidelity rendering effect with high efficiency. However, it still suffers from coarse density control and semantically blind loss functions when reconstructing the fine-grained structures in complex urban scenes. Thus, this study proposes SG-GS, a semantic-guided 3DGS method for fine-grained structure reconstruction. It takes the semantic segmentation deduced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as a constraint and systematically integrates it into both Gaussian density control and loss function design. On the one hand, a semantic-constrained adaptive density control mechanism is constructed, which dynamically allocates gradient thresholds to different semantic regions of the scene and introduces an additional boundary-enhanced densification strategy, so that new Gaussians are directed to structurally critical regions. On the other hand, a multi-feature guided loss function is designed, and fine-grained supervision signals are gradually introduced through a phased progressive training strategy, alleviating the artifacts caused by the lack of semantic constraints in the basic loss. Experiments on three datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction accuracy. Compared with the original 3DGS, the PSNR increases by approximately 2.7% to 5.2%, while artifacts on linear structures and boundary blurring are effectively mitigated. The method can serve the fine-grained 3D reconstruction of urban scenes.
tldr: 提出SG-GS，用SAM语义引导3DGS密度控制与损失设计，实现精细城市场景重建。
motivation: 原始3DGS在复杂城市场景中重建精细结构时，存在密度控制粗糙和损失函数缺乏语义感知的问题，易导致线性结构伪影与边界模糊。
method: 以SAM语义分割为约束，将其系统融入高斯密度控制与损失函数设计：构建语义约束自适应密度控制，按语义区域动态分配梯度阈值并引入边界增强致密化；同时设计多特征引导损失，并通过分阶段渐进训练逐步引入细粒度监督。
result: 在三个数据集上持续提升重建精度，相比原始3DGS的PSNR提高约2.7%至5.2%，并有效缓解线性结构伪影与边界模糊。
conclusion: SG-GS通过语义引导的密度控制与损失设计提升了城市场景精细重建质量，可服务于城市级细粒度三维重建任务。

title: Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.
tldr: Graph3R统一视图图初始化与前馈重建，用共享几何特征分离混合场景并提升重建与定位。
motivation: 未筛选图像集合常包含来自不相关场景的视图，联合重建会破坏相机位姿与几何；现有方法将视图关联与最终重建分阶段处理，视图图初始化与重建推断耦合松散。
method: 提出Graph3R，基于π³多视图特征，用轻量验证头预测成对共视以构建视图图，将输入视图划分为场景组；对每组掩码共享特征后解码相机位姿与稠密几何，单次骨干前向即可分别重建不相关场景。
result: 在三个基准上，Graph3R在100%精度下平均最大召回率较基线提升最多8.99个百分点，并改善混合场景输入的重建质量；在多会话建图任务中提升跨会话定位且位姿估计精度有竞争力，重建查询组时相对基线约35.9倍加速。
conclusion: 通过将学习式视图关联与几何推断集成，Graph3R朝着从未筛选图像集合进行端到端重建迈进一步，并兼顾重建质量、定位性能与运行效率。

title: DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian segmentation typically binds semantic features to the per-Gaussian state via per-scene gradient training (1-4 h) or the more recent closed-form distillation. Both commit each primitive to a single feature; therefore, boundary Gaussians spanning multiple 2D instances are forced into a hard decision that degrades retrieval accuracy and yields unstable mask boundaries at render time. We present DIGS, a training-free framework with two stages, class-agnostic mapping and multi-modal encoding, that decouples instance discovery from linguistic naming. At the Gaussian level, our distribution-informed representation maintains an explicit top-$M$ label distribution per primitive, updated by a tempered Dirichlet rule; preservation of multi-peaked label distributions at boundary primitives allows a late-argmax renderer to recover clean instance boundaries. A bidirectional state machine aggregates these distributions into a persistent class-agnostic instance ontology. The instance-level encoding stage then fuses the CLIP visual embedding of each instance's isolated 3D footprint with the CLIP-text embedding of an LLM-generated attribute description, disambiguating visually similar instances. On a single A100, DIGS completes mapping and instance encoding on LERF-OVS in 1.0-3.2 min per scene, depending on whether LLM fusion is enabled, and serves native 3D queries in 5.4 ms. It reaches 71.95% mean mIoU on LERF-OVS, outperforming both the training-free SFS and training-based LaGa baselines. DIGS also achieves the highest mean mIoU on LERF-Mask and 3D-OVS and surpasses Gaga and ObjectGS on Replica under their respective evaluation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrZos/DIGS.
tldr: DIGS以分布感知高斯表示与多模态编码实现免训练开放词汇3D分割，LERF-OVS mIoU达71.95%。
motivation: 现有开放词汇3D高斯分割依赖逐场景梯度训练（1-4小时）或闭式蒸馏，且每个primitive绑定单一特征，使跨多个2D实例的边界高斯被强制硬决策，导致检索精度下降与渲染掩码边界不稳定。
method: 提出免训练两阶段框架DIGS，包含类无关映射与多模态编码，将实例发现与语言命名解耦；高斯级维护top-M标签分布并用回火Dirichlet规则更新，保留边界多峰分布供late-argmax渲染恢复清晰边界，再用双向状态机聚合成持久类无关实例本体；实例级融合孤立3D足迹的CLIP视觉嵌入与LLM生成属性描述的CLIP文本嵌入以消歧。
result: 单张A100上LERF-OVS每场景映射与实例编码耗时1.0-3.2分钟（取决于是否启用LLM融合），原生3D查询仅5.4 ms；LERF-OVS平均mIoU达71.95%，超过免训练SFS与训练式LaGa；在LERF-Mask和3D-OVS取得最高平均mIoU，并在各自评估协议下于Replica超过Gaga与ObjectGS。
conclusion: DIGS证明分布感知表示与实例发现-语言命名解耦可在免训练条件下实现高精度开放词汇3D分割，兼顾快速建图与实时3D查询，为可扩展3D场景理解提供新方案，代码已开源。

title: All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking
abstract: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.
tldr: 提出All-St3R：基于RGB的实时动态SLAM，通过像素级运动掩码精确剔除运动物体，达约10 FPS。
motivation: 动态环境SLAM具有重要实用价值，但现有动态SLAM方法存在过度剔除动态区域和计算成本高的问题，且常依赖预定义标签或分割模型。
method: 结合DUSt3R基于ego-motion预测的像素运动与All-Tracker点跟踪，通过分析两种运动来源的差异生成像素级运动掩码，仅剔除当前实际运动像素，无需预定义标签或分割模型，并保留暂静态部分用于跟踪。
result: 系统以约10 FPS运行，通过每3帧子采样在标准30 FPS视频流上实现实时；仅依赖RGB输入，显著优于当前最先进的稠密动态SLAM方法（0.5-3 FPS）。
conclusion: 该工作提出了高实用性的实时RGB动态SLAM框架，实现像素级动态剔除并保留暂静态区域用于跟踪，有助于推动动态SLAM的实时化与实际部署。

title: Sharper Frames, Worse Rooms: Viewpoint Coverage Dominates Image Quality in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.
tldr: 固定视角预算下，视角覆盖比单帧清晰度更关键，只挑最清晰帧反而使房间重建误差剧增。
motivation: 前馈多视角重建模型受固定视角预算约束，帧选择成为关键的上游决策，而传统做法偏好清晰帧。作者质疑这一直觉，探究在室内手持扫描场景中图像质量优先的选择策略是否会损害几何重建与下游空间推理。
method: 在9段手持房间扫描上，从200个候选帧中按不同策略选取16帧，对比“最清晰帧”与均匀时间采样；进一步设计2×2析因实验，独立操纵视角分布广度与单帧清晰度，分离二者的主效应；最后检验推理阶段可得的两种不确定性信号（重建模型的多视角一致性分数与VLM置信度）能否察觉该失效。
result: 选取最清晰16帧是最差策略，房间尺寸误差达48%，而均匀时间采样仅3%；机制在于清晰帧多出现于慢速运动，选择集中于狭窄角度区间，示例中192°、最差单元格超300°的区域未被观测。析因实验显示视角分布的主效应约为清晰度的3倍，模糊但分布良好的帧在9次采集中的8次优于清晰但聚集的帧，且该优势随帧预算增大、角度覆盖饱和而减弱。此外，重建模型的多视角一致性分数随重建误差升高而升高，VLM置信度与其自身空间估计误差无关，均无法揭示该失效。
conclusion: 在小的视角预算下，视角覆盖是比单帧图像质量更强的约束，清晰度偏好会因与相机运动的耦合而系统性破坏空间覆盖。推理阶段现有的两类不确定性信号都无法暴露这一上游失败，提示需要面向覆盖度的帧选择策略与更可靠的不确定性度量，对多模态空间推理系统有直接意义。

title: ScenePlacer: Reformulating Scene-Level Object Pose Estimation as Visibility Field Learning
abstract: We present ScenePlacer, a framework for scene-level pose estimation of objects generated by state-of-the-art native shape generation models, placing generated 3D objects into scenes given a partial geometric observation without modifying the underlying generative pipeline. Existing scene generation approaches either generate objects directly in scene coordinates, compromising their canonical-space priors, or regress poses from complete generated shapes in the shape generation process - the latter being a poorly conditioned problem that is sensitive to scale ambiguity and partial observations. ScenePlacer decouples object generation from pose estimation by reformulating alignment as conditional visibility-field learning. Given an observed partial point cloud from reconstruction and a generated mesh, it predicts a visibility field defined in object space, then estimates the rigid transformation by aligning the partial observation to visible parts on the mesh. We propose a pretrained 3D shape VAE as our backbone, preserving its mesh prior while conditioning it on a separately encoded observation. We further introduce visibility-aware, radius-constrained supervision and synthesize training pairs using only object-level meshes and rendered views, eliminating the need for scene-level pose annotations. On 3D-FUTURE, ScenePlacer consistently outperforms existing placement and pose-refinement baselines under both ground-truth and monocular depth estimation. With generated objects, it achieves a Chamfer distance of 0.0077 and an F-score of 92.40 under estimated depth and improves to 0.0023 and 98.27, respectively, under ground-truth geometry.
tldr: ScenePlacer将场景级物体位姿估计重构为条件可见性场学习，无需场景位姿标注即可将生成物体对齐到部分观测。
motivation: 现有场景生成方法要么直接在场景坐标中生成物体，破坏其规范空间先验，要么从完整生成形状回归位姿，该问题病态且对尺度歧义和部分观测敏感。
method: ScenePlacer将物体生成与位姿估计解耦，给定重建的部分点云和生成网格，预测定义在物体空间的可见性场，再通过将部分观测与网格可见部分对齐来估计刚体变换。方法以预训练3D形状VAE为主干，在保留网格先验的同时条件于单独编码的观测，并引入可见性感知、半径约束监督，仅用物体级网格与渲染视图合成训练对，从而无需场景级位姿标注。
result: 在3D-FUTURE上，ScenePlacer在真值几何和单目深度估计下均持续优于现有摆放与位姿细化基线；对生成物体，在估计深度下达到Chamfer距离0.0077和F-score 92.40，在真值几何下提升至0.0023和98.27。
conclusion: ScenePlacer无需场景级位姿标注即可将生成3D物体放入场景，在保持生成模型规范先验的同时显著提升场景级位姿估计精度，为生成式场景构建提供了解耦对齐方案。

title: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
abstract: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/
tldr: UniForge3D在锚点引导的共享空间中联合重建与生成，从稀疏无位姿图像生成完整三维资产。
motivation: 从稀疏且无相机位姿的图像生成完整3D资产，需在补全未见区域的同时保留输入中已观测的几何；然而相机相关的重建与规范空间的生成之间存在坐标不匹配，且对每个3D位置无差别地融合所有视角会混入无关图像内容，损害局部细节恢复。
method: 提出UniForge3D，在共享的锚点引导空间中联合建模重建与生成：该空间沿用锚点视角的方位角并保持物体竖直，从而消除坐标不匹配；两个分支双向交换特征，预测逐视角点图与完整稀疏体素结构，并以生成结构为条件预测点图，建立像素到体素的对应关系，为每个体素挑选信息量最大的输入视角，再用所选视角特征引导精细形状生成。
result: 在Toys4K与GSO数据集上，该方法在外观与几何指标上均取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）结果，生成的完整3D资产保真度更高。
conclusion: 该工作表明通过共享锚点引导空间与双向特征交互可有效统一3D重建与生成，在保留观测几何的同时借助生成先验补全缺失区域；项目主页为 https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/。

title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
tldr: Splat2Act用手机扫描构建场景数字孪生，自动生成演示并两阶段微调VLA，实现个性化抓取。
motivation: 通用操作策略进入家庭或办公室后，希望从货架、柜台和桌面抓取用户物品；但强通用策略π0.5在捕获的部署场景中不做适配时抓取成功率为0%，而在每个用户环境采集真实演示成本过高。因此需要仅凭手机扫描和物品图像，将预训练VLA个性化到特定场景与物体集合。
method: 提出Splat2Act，一个自动化real-to-sim-to-real流水线：用3D Gaussian Splatting和碰撞几何构建建筑级真实感数字孪生，自动发现桌面与非桌面容器，构造可行抓取任务，并用特权仿真oracle生成成功演示，人类只需采集场景和物体。随后两阶段微调π0.5：阶段1在部署场景或全部101个场景的数百个公共物体资产上适配，阶段2在部署场景容器上针对用户自有物体个性化。
result: 在101个校园扫描环境（可导航面积中位数104.87 m²、7个容器）上，流水线生成852个容器和超过68,000条抓取演示；最强个性化策略在目标场景达到62.5%总体抓取成功率。部署到真实Stretch 3后，同一策略在12个任务子集上成功率为63.9%，接近其仿真66.7%。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅使用仿真oracle数据的自动化real-to-sim-to-real训练即可个性化VLA操作策略，无需在用户环境采集真实演示，为家庭和办公场景的机器人部署提供了可扩展路径。

title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
abstract: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.
tldr: 将2D光流提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场来形变高斯基元，在静态3DGS场景中实现循环流动的水动画。
motivation: 现有3D Gaussian Splatting等显式3D表示假设场景静态，限制了真实感；而流水这类高频动态效果在随意拍摄条件下无法通过稠密多视角高速采集来重建或物理模拟。
method: 从参考图像或模型渲染结果中估计2D光流，并将其提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；提出受cinemagraph（动态静图）启发的算法，用该运动场变形高斯基元，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。
result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集上评估，在视觉质量和计算效率上均明显优于先前的动态高斯泼溅与3D cinemagraph生成方法，同时保持实时渲染性能。
conclusion: 该方法无需动态采集或物理仿真即可为静态3DGS场景添加视觉上合理的水流动画，显著提升感知真实感，并保留自由视点导航能力。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
abstract: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.
tldr: SimVTA利用仿真渲染未来视频为高奖励轨迹提供视觉监督，结合GRPO与流匹配提升驾驶规划性能。
motivation: 驾驶日志仅记录已记录轨迹的未来视频，强化学习探索的替代轨迹缺乏对应视觉监督，导致世界动作模型后训练中的规划改进受限。
method: 对每个观测采样候选轨迹，用World Engine等真实感仿真器在3DGS重建场景中为高奖励候选渲染未来视频，并在有限渲染预算下优先监督高误差未来。采用GRPO优化轨迹规划，同时对匹配视频施加流匹配损失以更新共享表征；推理时直接预测轨迹，无需调用仿真器。
result: 在NAVSIM v1上，将SimVTA应用于WAM初始化使PDMS从86.2提升至91.3（+5.1）；在NAVSIM v2上达到88.2 EPDMS；在HUGSIM闭环评估中平均HD-Score为38.8。消融表明，用视频监督更新共享表征可改善规划，且在高奖励轨迹中优先高误差未来能进一步提升性能。
conclusion: SimVTA将仿真渲染的轨迹匹配视频监督与强化学习后训练相结合，为驾驶世界动作模型提供替代轨迹的视觉监督，显著提升规划性能且推理阶段无需仿真器调用。

title: Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen
abstract: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.
tldr: 提出基于2DGS的反射建模框架，利用输入图像中直接可见环境信息与混合反射外观，提升近场镜面反射的新视角合成质量。
motivation: NeRF与3DGS等新视角合成方法在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关镜面反射，尤其是近场反射；现有环境贴图仅表示无穷远光源，环境高斯仅依赖反射间接监督，均不足以准确建模此类效果。
method: 提出基于2D Gaussian Splatting（2DGS）的框架，利用输入图像中可直接观测的环境信息，并集成混合反射外观表示与视角相关镜面建模。
result: 在公开基准和新建近场反射数据集上实验，表明该方法在渲染质量和几何精度上均取得更优表现。
conclusion: 该工作通过直接可见环境信息与混合反射表示提升了近场反射建模能力，为高保真视角合成提供了新思路。

title: PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components
abstract: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .
tldr: PhysForge 提出基于视频扩散模型的可控材质物理重建框架，通过 PhysFit 与 PhysComp 实现材质可控拟合和部件级交互建模。
motivation: 现有物理 3D 生成方法虽能产生视觉逼真且可仿真的资产，但对材质行为的控制有限，往往只能依赖外观推断，并且难以从物体与语义部件间的复杂交互中估计物理属性。本文旨在解决材质可控物理拟合与部件级交互建模问题。
method: PhysForge 是基于视频扩散模型（VDM）的框架，包含 PhysFit 与 PhysComp 两个模块。PhysFit 以材质条件 VDM 动力学为参考进行物理属性拟合，引入窗口化拟合聚焦材质显著交互，并用 Hallucinated Forcing 分离 VDM 产生的非物理运动幻觉与真实材质响应；PhysComp 将复杂交互分解为单个物体和语义组件，使物理参数可独立优化并灵活组合以进行联合仿真。
result: 在 PhysAssets 和 Google Scanned Objects 数据集上，PhysForge 相比现有方法对材质相关物理响应具有更强控制力，并支持复杂交互的部件级物理建模。它在常见与不常见材质上均取得最佳 CLIP 和物理可控性分数，定性比较、部件级消融和用户研究进一步验证了这些改进。
conclusion: PhysForge 通过可分离组件实现材质可控的物理 3D 重建，提升了物理属性拟合与部件级交互仿真的可控性。该工作为生成可仿真、材质可调控的 3D 资产提供了新思路，并展示了在复杂材质与交互场景中的潜力。

title: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
abstract: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.
tldr: 基于图像误差与学习置信度的置信感知致密化，在固定预算MCMC框架下超越3DGS-MCMC并媲美先验方法。
motivation: 3DGS-MCMC基于不透明度的采样使新图元集中在前景，导致背景重建不足；低预算下ConeGS、EDGS等基于先验的方法更优，但需预训练辐射场或稠密图像匹配及额外初始化阶段。
method: 在固定预算MCMC框架中回归误差驱动致密化：保留固定预算与渐进增长，但依据图像误差放置图元，主要在屏幕空间梯度较大处采样新图元；偏好学习置信度低的图元（即重建仍差的区域），并将对渲染贡献最小的图元重定位到这些位置。
result: 在24个场景上，100k至2M各预算下PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均优于3DGS-MCMC；100k时无需先验与初始化即恢复ConeGS领先3DGS-MCMC的1.05dB PSNR中的0.84dB；500k起在所有固定预算方法（含ConeGS、EDGS）中PSNR与SSIM最高。以ConeGS或EDGS初始化时，100k匹配ConeGS的PSNR与SSIM，500k三项指标均最优。
conclusion: 表明误差驱动的置信感知致密化可在免先验条件下显著提升固定预算3DGS的重建质量，同时能兼容并利用先验初始化，为无先验与先验场景提供统一高效方案。

title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.
tldr: SplatQ通过区域预算平滑与QUBO联合选择剪枝3DGS，提升重建质量平衡与渲染速度。
motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝多基于独立重要性分数的全局Top-K选择，缺乏区域预算控制且忽略高斯联合删除效应，导致场景重建质量不平衡。
method: SplatQ将高斯按空间邻近性和外观相似性划分为限大小块，将全局选择分解为固定规模子问题；平滑基于重要性的块保留配额，并用代表性像素颜色对不透明度变化的响应构造联合删除的二次近似；将个体响应、成对交互和配额惩罚纳入QUBO目标，用模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解以联合选择高斯。
result: 在5个基准上，SplatQ在总体重建质量、空间质量平衡和渲染速度上优于最先进剪枝方法；消融表明预算平滑改善局部细节重建，交互建模提升固定预算下高斯选择质量。
conclusion: SplatQ通过组合剪枝协调区域预算分配与联合高斯选择，为3DGS压缩提供交互感知的QUBO优化框架，并可利用SA/CIM求解，具有提升渲染效率与场景质量平衡的潜力。

title: NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement
abstract: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.
tldr: NovaSplat利用手机视频构建3DGS表示，实现无模型6D物体位姿估计与精化，并推出加速版Lite。
motivation: 无CAD模型的新物体6D位姿估计仍是开放难题：无模型方法需在onboarding阶段从头构建物体表示，性能长期落后于基于模型的方法。NovaSplat旨在缩小这一差距。
method: 从onboarding阶段拍摄的短智能手机视频训练3D Gaussian Splatting模型，既作为检测与粗位姿估计的模板来源，又作为可微骨干进行位姿精化。精化器在无梯度奇异点的连续旋转参数化下，结合光度损失与几何损失优化物体到相机位姿。
result: 在家居物体基准上超越所有基于模型的方法；在包含无纹理和镜面表面的工业基准上优于所有无模型竞争者，并显著缩小与基于模型方法的差距。NovaSplat-Lite推理变体速度提升3.1倍，精度损失可忽略。
conclusion: NovaSplat证明基于3DGS的onboarding与可微精化可让无模型6D位姿估计达到甚至超越基于模型方法，并提升工业等挑战场景的实用性；代码将开源。

title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.
tldr: CompactSplat通过纹理引导空间划分与分层采样，实现前馈稀疏视角场景的自适应高斯分布重建。
motivation: 稀疏视角下无需逐场景优化的三维重建仍具挑战，尤其难以恢复准确几何与细节纹理。现有前馈3DGS方法通常为每个像素分配一个或多个高斯，导致均匀分配在平坦区域产生大量冗余，且未利用平面表面的几何先验，造成结构建模次优。
method: 提出CompactSplat前馈框架，融合纹理引导的空间划分与分层采样，实现内容感知的高斯分配：在复杂区域集中密集高斯，在平坦区域用扩展且尺度调制的基元平铺。该框架还天然支持推理时动态稀疏控制，无需重新训练即可在渲染保真度与内存占用之间灵活权衡。
result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV和ScanNet上，CompactSplat在标准指标和高分辨率渲染一致性上均持续优于先前方法，并以显著更少的高斯基元实现高保真重建；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: CompactSplat通过内容感知的高斯分配缓解了前馈3DGS的冗余与结构建模不足问题，并支持推理时稀疏控制，为稀疏视角场景重建提供了高保真且资源高效的解决方案，有望推动可泛化3DGS在实际应用中的部署。

title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
abstract: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.
tldr: 提出区域与深度监督的可测量语义3DGS框架及AEC-SplatTwin平台，用于交互式建筑巡检。
motivation: 仅靠照片级3D重建难以满足建筑巡检所需的几何可测量性、语义结构和交互式信息访问，需将3DGS扩展为面向工程的量测与语义表示。
method: 提出可测量语义3DGS：用掩码区域监督抑制背景并聚焦目标，用MVS点云生成点级深度监督将高斯中心锚定到物理表面；同时为每个高斯基元关联可学习类别特征形成语义高斯场，并构建AEC-SplatTwin交互平台支持实时可视化、语义分析、定量测量和MLLM辅助交互。
result: 在合成UAV巡检QuakeCity和智能手机采集HKUPB上，高斯中心深度MAE分别降低58.1%和86.8%，语义场mIoU达0.8529和0.8642；HKUPB的高度、宽度、面积平均相对误差分别为0.33%、1.07%、0.60%。
conclusion: 结果表明该框架将3DGS从视觉重建拓展为可测量、语义结构化、可交互的工程表示，提升建筑巡检的实用性与可量测性。

title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
abstract: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.
tldr: 提出将2D光流提升为3D欧拉运动场并变形高斯原语，在静态3DGS场景中实现无缝循环流水动画。
motivation: 现有3DGS等显式表示通常假设静态场景，难以处理真实环境中普遍存在的动态现象；流水等高频效应在随意拍摄条件下因缺乏密集多视角、高速采集而难以重建。本文旨在无需动态采集或物理模拟的前提下，为静态3DGS场景中的水体添加视觉合理的运动。
method: 方法从参考图像或模型渲染结果中估计2D光流，并将其提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；随后提出受cinemagraph启发的算法，利用该运动场变形高斯原语，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。该表示保持实时渲染性能，并保留场景内的自由视点导航能力。
result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集上进行评估，相比动态高斯泼溅和3D cinemagraph生成等先前工作，在视觉质量和计算效率上均取得明显提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法实现了静态3DGS场景中的水体动画，无需动态捕捉或物理仿真，同时保留实时渲染和自由视点浏览，显著增强感知真实感。其贡献在于为随意拍摄场景中的高频动态效果提供了一种高效、可循环的3DGS动画方案。

It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements.
